summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Royal Crypto Rewards Phase 1 enterprise features. 24/24 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, transaction ledger, withdrawal lifecycle (6 stages with single-debit & refund correctness), deposit approval crediting, activity tracking, support tickets (full thread + admin reply + status updates), live feed, bulk bonus & commission, notifications with categories. Frontend: admin login -> admin dashboard, user login -> dashboard, all admin sub-pages (/admin/transactions, /admin/tickets, /admin/bulk, /admin/feed, /admin/activity) load without errors, notification bell present, mobile bottom nav appears on 390x844, public pages (/, /plans, /about, /register) load. 0 console errors detected.

minor.issue: Server lowercases email silently — fine but undocumented. Test originally failed because TEST_ prefix returned lowercased.

When updating only `balance` field, all four ledger types are routed correctly, but for balance the type uses sign-based admin_credit/admin_debit while other ledger_fields entries (daily_profit etc) ignore sign — works but inconsistent labelling.

issues: Page <title> tag remains 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be branded 'Royal Crypto Rewards'

action_items: (Optional) Update document.title to 'Royal Crypto Rewards' in /app/frontend/public/index.html for branding consistency.
Phase 1 enterprise backend and integration work as specified — no critical fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1299 lines — should be split into auth.py, admin.py, tickets.py, ledger.py modules for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — OK since auth is via Bearer header; but cookie path /api/auth/login also sets httpOnly cookie that will not be sent cross-origin. Make explicit origins if cookies are intended.
Withdrawal balance debit logic correctly debits once on first transition to approved/processing/completed and refunds on rejection from a debited state — verified by tests.
Bulk bonus and balance-adjust ledger entries properly use record_tx and exclude _id. Good.
Public /api/public/feed has no rate limiter — consider throttle for production.

admin_required dependency does not respect admin_role permissions on most admin endpoints (only require_perm dep would). Currently every admin role can do everything because routes use admin_required, not require_perm — RBAC partial implementation.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests created TEST_ prefixed tickets, feed items, bulk bonuses; demo user balance restored after tests where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_royal_crypto_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_N.xml`. JWT comes back in access_token JSON field; send as Authorization: Bearer. Demo user balance is mutated by tests (deposits/withdrawals/bulk) so balance assertions reset balance first via PATCH /api/admin/users/{uid}. RBAC granular permissions defined in PERMISSIONS map but not actually enforced (admin_required is used everywhere instead of require_perm).
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all flows working as designed in this iteration.
